meta_description_en: News from the 8-bit scene in March 1992: the 10th anniversary of the ZX Spectrum, magazine circulation drops, Romantic Robot sales, SAMCo, Modula-2, and more.
meta_description_ru: Новости 8-битного мира за март 1992 года: 10-летие ZX Spectrum, падение тиражей журналов, распродажи Romantic Robot, инициатива SAMCo, Modula-2 и другое.
body_en_plain:
M A R C H ,   1 9 9 2

       ANYONE FOR TEN-ISH?

A grand celebration of the tenth
year of the Spectrum is being
planned for May 2nd at Cambridge
University Centre!Clive Sinclair
and other dignitaries will hold
a seminar(seats:`7.50) from 2pm;
films will be shown and various
Spectrums displayed(+ emulators,
including SAM). The meet:"ZX92",
is still in the planning stage.
I'll keep you informed...

             SUNSET?
As devotees plan to rejoice at a
birthday,there's a growing gloom
as of the era's funeral:SINCLAIR
USER files a circulation of only
35,000(down 10,000 in 6 months);
YOUR SINCLAIR is down 6,000 to
59,000; larger games producers
stop production of full-price
Spectrum games and YOUR SINCLAIR
tries,Canute-like,a "Support our
Speccy" rally to win them back.

I've heard that a periodical has
to sell at least 40,000 to keep
a place in W.H. Smiths. If so,it
looks very ominous for SINCLAIR
USER over the next few months.
Mind you,the magazine,as we knew
it, faded long ago.Leave me weep
o'er my Issue 1's painful cover.

            FACE DOWN
An advantage of a failing market
is there may be bargains to be
had.Romantic Robot now offer the
entire MULTIFACE range at `29.95
plus `2 delivery. These gadgets
save programs loaded from tape
directly to disc effortlessly at
the touch of a button. There is
MULTIFACE 1 (48K/128+/+2 in 48K
mode,saves to tape/+D/ Disciple/
microdrive/Opus); MULTIFACE 128
(48K/128K/+2 in 48 or 128K mode;
MULTIFACE 3(+3/+2A to disc/tape)
MULTIPRINT (48K/128K/+2 printer
interface; VIDEOFACE: video to
Spectrum screen digitizer. They
are at 54 Deanscroft Ave.,London
NW9 8EN (081 200 8870).ROMANTIC
ROBOT are deserting the Spectrum
for the 16-bit machines so get
in quick!

     SAMCO SUPPORT SPECTRUM

Following the fade out of larger
Spectrum game publishers, SAMCo,
producers of the SAM Coupe, are
looking for unpublished Spectrum
games which they hope to publish
AS Spectrum games. They are not
looking (necessarily) to convert
them to SAM but to give a chance
of publication to anyone who has
written a game for the Spectrum
but was unable previously to get
it published.

If you have written a Spectrum
game of at least reasonable
commercial quality then get in
touch with SAMCo, Lakeside,
Phoenix Way, Swansea Enterprise
park, Swansea, SA7 9EH.

     NOT SO SWEET FOR SUGAR
For the first time ever, Amstrad
have made a loss after being put
out of the leisure side of the
computing market due to its un-
profitability(for them!).Amstrad
lost `15 million in the last six
months of last year.

            LANGUAGE!
There is now a version of the
programming language "Modula-2"
for the Spectrum. This has been
produced by MIRA SOFTWARE, 24
Home Close, Kibworth, Leicester-
shire, LE8 0JT and costs `20 on
+3/+D or Disciple disc.It's also
available on tape in a form that
can be put onto other systems.
MIRA have already produced two
other languages for the Spectrum
(FORTRAN and PASCAL).

        GAMES DISCOVERED

It's most curious that after all
these years the media is start-
ing to realize that computer
games are popular!Television and
the daily press gave them little
or no coverage. However,now that
Channel 4's GAMESMASTER is doing
so well, some of the tabloid
newspapers, lead aggressively by
the Daily Mirror, are now really
promoting "games sections" with
gusto. The Daily Mirror has had
a feeble sort of "Computer Club"
for a while now but is finally
raising the ante with a full-
page, full-colour feature called
"POWER UP". Strange that so many
millions of games have been sold
in previous years unnoticed!

            BOOK NOW
Many of you are fans of FINANCE
MANAGER published by OCP. Well,
Francis Miles, (who wrote WORD
MANAGER) has now written a new
accounts package inspired by the
best features of FINANCE MANAGER
but with improvements and extras
(it is virtually a rewrite of
FINANCE MANAGER). The new soft-
ware is called THE BOOKKEEPER
and enables you to keep home or
business accounts on any disc or
cartridge system for the 48K
Spectrum. BK boasts  a 64-column
screen and other enhancements.It
comes (on tape, with SAVE/PRINT
options in BASIC for easy change
to your system)for `10 from F.G.
Miles, "Windrush", Rabley Heath,
Welwyn, Herts, AL6 9UF (Tel:
0438 813406).

   ALL-FORMATS COMPUTER FAIRS

MAR
 8 City Hall,Candleriggs,Glasgow
14 Novotel, Hammersmith, London
15 Brunel Centre,T/Meads,Bristol
21 Donington Park (Jnctn 23A,M1)
22 University Sport Centre,Leeds

APR
12 Northumbria Centre,Washington
26 M'cycle Museum,B'ham(J6,M42)

All:10am-4pm.`4 entry. Car park.

On sale should be hardware and
software of all kinds for most
computers. Although the 16-bits
tend to dominate these days, the
Spectrum and SAM are represented
- but in varying degrees!

         PIRATE PINCHED

A software pirate has been given
a four-month suspended sentence
for running a mail-order firm
selling his own copies of well-
known games.Not only was he just
copying discs, he'd found a way
to copy some of the new games
cartridges!

              SIR?

Sir Clive Sinclair is to launch
a new... wait for it... electric
bicycle this summer. It will be
street legal for 14-year olds to
ride this powered vehicle.Joking
apart, maybe this could really
take off in a big way? Whoops,
sorry,I didn't mean that the way
it sounded.

      PERSONAL INFORMATION

I have more info on the PERSONAL
BANKING SYSTEM reported in Issue
52. It features: auto-posting of
standing orders/direct debits;
flexible interrogation; forward
projection;detailed statements;
monitoring;Bank statement check;
VAT;suits private,club or small
business;analysis,account and
general ledger;75-page manual
and other extras. It's `19.95 on
SAM Coupe (any), `12 on Spectrum
(any) on tape,microdrive,Plus D,
Disciple and Opus.

Contact Hilton Computer Services
Ltd., 3 Suffolk Drive,Guildford,
Surrey, GU4 7FD (0483 578983).

                        - Brian.
body_en:
### Anyone for Ten-ish?

A grand celebration of the tenth year of the Spectrum is being planned for May 2nd at Cambridge University Centre! Clive Sinclair and other dignitaries will hold a seminar (seats: £7.50) from 2pm; films will be shown and various Spectrums displayed (+ emulators, including SAM). The meet, "ZX92", is still in the planning stage. I'll keep you informed...

### Sunset?

As devotees plan to rejoice at a birthday, there's a growing gloom as of the era's funeral: *Sinclair User* files a circulation of only 35,000 (down 10,000 in 6 months); *Your Sinclair* is down 6,000 to 59,000; larger games producers stop production of full-price Spectrum games and *Your Sinclair* tries, Canute-like, a "Support our Speccy" rally to win them back.

I've heard that a periodical has to sell at least 40,000 to keep a place in W.H. Smiths. If so, it looks very ominous for *Sinclair User* over the next few months. Mind you, the magazine, as we knew it, faded long ago. Leave me weep o'er my Issue 1's painful cover.

### Face Down

An advantage of a failing market is there may be bargains to be had. Romantic Robot now offer the entire Multiface range at £29.95 plus £2 delivery. These gadgets save programs loaded from tape directly to disc effortlessly at the touch of a button. There is Multiface 1 (48K/128+/+2 in 48K mode, saves to tape/+D/Disciple/microdrive/Opus); Multiface 128 (48K/128K/+2 in 48 or 128K mode); Multiface 3 (+3/+2A to disc/tape); Multiprint (48K/128K/+2 printer interface); Videoface (video to Spectrum screen digitizer). They are at 54 Deanscroft Ave., London NW9 8EN (081 200 8870). Romantic Robot are deserting the Spectrum for the 16-bit machines, so get in quick!

### SAMCo Support Spectrum

Following the fade out of larger Spectrum game publishers, SAMCo, producers of the SAM Coupé, are looking for unpublished Spectrum games which they hope to publish *as* Spectrum games. They are not looking (necessarily) to convert them to SAM but to give a chance of publication to anyone who has written a game for the Spectrum but was unable previously to get it published.

If you have written a Spectrum game of at least reasonable commercial quality, then get in touch with SAMCo, Lakeside, Phoenix Way, Swansea Enterprise Park, Swansea, SA7 9EH.

### Not So Sweet for Sugar

For the first time ever, Amstrad have made a loss after being put out of the leisure side of the computing market due to its unprofitability (for them!). Amstrad lost £15 million in the last six months of last year.

### Language!

There is now a version of the programming language "Modula-2" for the Spectrum. This has been produced by Mira Software, 24 Home Close, Kibworth, Leicestershire, LE8 0JT and costs £20 on +3/+D or Disciple disc. It's also available on tape in a form that can be put onto other systems. Mira have already produced two other languages for the Spectrum (FORTRAN and Pascal).

### Games Discovered

It's most curious that after all these years the media is starting to realize that computer games are popular! Television and the daily press gave them little or no coverage. However, now that Channel 4's *GamesMaster* is doing so well, some of the tabloid newspapers, led aggressively by the *Daily Mirror*, are now really promoting "games sections" with gusto. The *Daily Mirror* has had a feeble sort of "Computer Club" for a while now but is finally raising the ante with a full-page, full-colour feature called "Power Up". Strange that so many millions of games have been sold in previous years unnoticed!

### Book Now

Many of you are fans of *Finance Manager* published by OCP. Well, Francis Miles (who wrote *Word Manager*) has now written a new accounts package inspired by the best features of *Finance Manager* but with improvements and extras (it is virtually a rewrite of *Finance Manager*). The new software is called *The Bookkeeper* and enables you to keep home or business accounts on any disc or cartridge system for the 48K Spectrum. BK boasts a 64-column screen and other enhancements. It comes (on tape, with SAVE/PRINT options in BASIC for easy change to your system) for £10 from F.G. Miles, "Windrush", Rabley Heath, Welwyn, Herts, AL6 9UF (Tel: 0438 813406).

### All-Formats Computer Fairs

**MARCH**
* 8: City Hall, Candleriggs, Glasgow
* 14: Novotel, Hammersmith, London
* 15: Brunel Centre, Temple Meads, Bristol
* 21: Donington Park (Jnctn 23A, M1)
* 22: University Sport Centre, Leeds

**APRIL**
* 12: Northumbria Centre, Washington
* 26: Motorcycle Museum, Birmingham (J6, M42)

All fairs run 10am–4pm. Entry £4. Car park available.

On sale should be hardware and software of all kinds for most computers. Although the 16-bits tend to dominate these days, the Spectrum and SAM are represented — but in varying degrees!

### Pirate Pinched

A software pirate has been given a four-month suspended sentence for running a mail-order firm selling his own copies of well-known games. Not only was he just copying discs, he'd found a way to copy some of the new games cartridges!

### Sir?

Sir Clive Sinclair is to launch a new... wait for it... electric bicycle this summer. It will be street legal for 14-year-olds to ride this powered vehicle. Joking apart, maybe this could really take off in a big way? Whoops, sorry, I didn't mean that the way it sounded.

### Personal Information

I have more info on the *Personal Banking System* reported in Issue 52. It features: auto-posting of standing orders/direct debits; flexible interrogation; forward projection; detailed statements; monitoring; bank statement check; VAT; suits private, club or small business; analysis, account and general ledger; 75-page manual and other extras. It's £19.95 on SAM Coupé (any), £12 on Spectrum (any) on tape, microdrive, Plus D, Disciple and Opus.

Contact Hilton Computer Services Ltd., 3 Suffolk Drive, Guildford, Surrey, GU4 7FD (0483 578983).

— Brian.
body_ru:
### Кому десяточку?

2 мая в University Centre в Кембридже планируется грандиозное празднование десятилетия Спектрума! Клайв Синклер и другие высокопоставленные лица проведут семинар (билеты: £7.50) с двух часов дня; будут показаны фильмы и выставлены различные модели Спектрума (плюс эмуляторы, включая SAM). Встреча под названием «ZX92» пока находится на стадии планирования. Буду держать вас в курсе...

### Закат?

Пока преданные поклонники готовятся праздновать день рождения, сгущаются тучи, будто на похоронах эпохи: тираж *Sinclair User* упал всего до 35 000 экземпляров (минус 10 000 за полгода); тираж *Your Sinclair* снизился на 6 000 — до 59 000. Крупные разработчики сворачивают производство игр для Spectrum по полной цене, а *Your Sinclair*, подобно королю Кнуду, безуспешно пытается организовать кампанию «Support our Speccy», чтобы вернуть их обратно.

Я слышал, что периодическому изданию необходимо продавать как минимум 40 000 копий, чтобы сохранять место на полках W.H. Smiths. Если это правда, то ближайшие несколько месяцев выглядят для *Sinclair User* весьма тревожно. Впрочем, тот журнал, который мы знали, угас уже давным-давно. Позвольте мне просто поплакать над ностальгической обложкой первого номера.

### Лицом вниз

Плюс падающего рынка в том, что на нём можно урвать выгодные предложения. Romantic Robot сейчас распродаёт всю линейку Multiface по цене £29.95 плюс £2 за доставку. Эти устройства позволяют одним нажатием кнопки сохранять программы прямо с ленты на диск. Доступны: Multiface 1 (48K/128+/+2 в режиме 48K, сохраняет на ленту/+D/Disciple/microdrive/Opus); Multiface 128 (48K/128K/+2 в режимах 48K или 128K); Multiface 3 (+3/+2A на диск/ленту); Multiprint (интерфейс принтера для 48K/128K/+2); Videoface (оцифровщик видеосигнала для экрана Spectrum). Их адрес: 54 Deanscroft Ave., London NW9 8EN (081 200 8870). Romantic Robot уходят со Спектрума на 16-битные платформы, так что поторопитесь!

### SAMCo поддерживает Spectrum

На фоне ухода крупных издателей игр для Спектрума компания SAMCo, создатели SAM Coupé, ищет неизданные спектрумовские игры, надеясь выпустить их именно *как* игры для Спектрума. Они вовсе не требуют обязательного портирования на SAM, а просто хотят дать шанс на публикацию всем, кто написал игру для Спектрума, но до сих пор не смог её издать.

Если вы создали игру для Спектрума хотя бы разумного коммерческого качества — свяжитесь с SAMCo: Lakeside, Phoenix Way, Swansea Enterprise Park, Swansea, SA7 9EH.

### Несладко для Шугара

Впервые в своей истории компания Amstrad зафиксировала убытки после ухода с рынка потребительских домашних компьютеров из-за его нерентабельности (для них самих!). За последние шесть месяцев прошлого года Amstrad потеряла 15 миллионов фунтов стерлингов.

### Выбирайте выражения!

Для Спектрума появилась версия языка программирования «Modula-2». Её выпустила компания Mira Software (24 Home Close, Kibworth, Leicestershire, LE8 0JT), стоимость составляет £20 на дискетах для +3/+D или Disciple. Доступна также версия на кассете в формате, позволяющем перенести её на другие системы. Ранее Mira уже выпустила для Спектрума два других языка (FORTRAN и Pascal).

### Игры замечены

Удивительно, но спустя столько лет пресса наконец начинает осознавать, что компьютерные игры — это популярно! Телевидение и ежедневные газеты почти или совсем не уделяли им внимания. Однако теперь, когда шоу *GamesMaster* на Channel 4 пользуется огромным успехом, некоторые бульварные издания — во главе с напористой *Daily Mirror* — с энтузиазмом взялись за «игровые разделы». У *Daily Mirror* некоторое время существовал довольно вялый «Computer Club», но теперь они поднимают ставки, запуская полностраничную цветную рубрику «Power Up». Странно, что миллионы проданных в прошлые годы игр они просто не замечали!

### Бухгалтерия наготове

Многие из вас любят программу *Finance Manager* от OCP. Так вот, Фрэнсис Майлз (автор *Word Manager*) написал новый пакет ведения счетов, вдохновлённый лучшими чертами *Finance Manager*, но с доработками и дополнениями (по сути, это полная переработка программы). Новый пакет называется *The Bookkeeper* и позволяет вести домашнюю или корпоративную бухгалтерию на любой дисковой системе или микродрайвах для 48K Spectrum. Программа может похвастаться 64-колоночным текстовым экраном и другими улучшениями. Она поставляется на кассете с опциями SAVE/PRINT на Бейсике для удобной адаптации под вашу систему за £10: F.G. Miles, «Windrush», Rabley Heath, Welwyn, Herts, AL6 9UF (Тел: 0438 813406).

### Мультиформатные компьютерные ярмарки

**МАРТ**
* 8: City Hall, Candleriggs, Glasgow
* 14: Novotel, Hammersmith, London
* 15: Brunel Centre, Temple Meads, Bristol
* 21: Donington Park (Jnctn 23A, M1)
* 22: University Sport Centre, Leeds

**АПРЕЛЬ**
* 12: Northumbria Centre, Washington
* 26: Motorcycle Museum, Birmingham (J6, M42)

Время работы всех ярмарок — с 10:00 до 16:00. Вход £4. Есть парковка.

В продаже ожидается всевозможное «железо» и софт для большинства компьютеров. Хотя сейчас правят бал 16-битки, Spectrum и SAM тоже будут представлены — пусть и в разном масштабе!

### Пират попался

Один софтверный пират получил четыре месяца тюрьмы условно за ведение почтовой торговли собственными нелегальными копиями популярных игр. Он не только копировал дискеты, но и нашёл способ копировать некоторые из новых игровых картриджей!

### Сэр Клайв?

Этим летом сэр Клайв Синклер собирается запустить новый... погодите-ка... электрический велосипед! Управлять этим транспортным средством на дорогах общего пользования закон разрешит с 14 лет. Шутки в сторону, но вдруг эта штука действительно взлетит? Ой, простите, я не то имел в виду!

### Личные финансы

У меня появилась дополнительная информация о программе *Personal Banking System*, о которой мы упоминали в 52-м номере. Её возможности: автоматическое проведение постоянных поручений и прямых списаний, гибкие запросы, прогнозирование баланса, подробные выписки, мониторинг, сверка банковских отчётов, расчёт НДС; подходит для личного пользования, клубов или малого бизнеса; аналитика, счета и главная книга; руководство пользователя на 75 страницах и прочие плюсы. Цена: £19.95 для SAM Coupé (любого), £12 для Spectrum (любого) на кассете, микродрайве, Plus D, Disciple и Opus.

Контакты: Hilton Computer Services Ltd., 3 Suffolk Drive, Guildford, Surrey, GU4 7FD (0483 578983).

— Brian.
